description: Orient yourself in one wiki, in a single call: returns its metadata, `scope` (coverage / not-covered / freshness), document count, the entry document, and a `map` of all documents (paths + titles, grouped by folder) so you can pick what to read_document next. Use a slug from list_wikis. Free tier: the map omits Pro (XL) pages. The response's `xl` field says how many exist and where to list them; set AGENTWIKIS_API_KEY to include them.
name: open_wiki
